title: Shelby County Jail Roof Project: Addendum Released With Updated Bid Details for Local Contractors - NewsBreak
text:
2 hours ago On December 10, 2025, Shelby County released Addendum No. 1 for the Jail Roof Replacement Project. The addendum updates and clarifies information for contractors interested in bidding. The bid opening is set for Thursday, December 18, 2025, at 2:00 p.m. It will be held at the office of the Shelby County Chief Financial Officer, 200 West College Street, Room 125, Columbiana, Alabama, 35051.
The addendum includes notes and a sign-in sheet from the mandatory pre-bid conference. It also revises several sections of the project manual, plans, and specifications. Section 00200 clarifies the required notation for bid envelopes. Section 01 1100 updates the summary of work. Section 07 5419 provides specifications for polyvinyl-chloride (PVC) roofing. All gutters and downspouts will be replaced and included in the contractor’s base bid.
Two substitution requests for PVC roofing materials have been approved: Carlisle Sure-Flex 80 mil and Johns Manville JM PVC SD Plus 80 mil. Contractors may use these materials if they meet project requirements.
The addendum answers contractor questions. All existing gutters and downspouts will be replaced with new 6-inch gutters and 4x5-inch downspouts, matching the current size and shape. In areas with shorter gutter back legs, new gutters will match the original dimensions and use 24-gauge Kynar Finish materials.
Other clarifications cover the installation of two-piece compression metal at coping removal locations, procedures for fireproofing damage, and updated roofing system specifications. The contractor must disconnect, protect, and reinstall the existing lightning protection system. The owner will handle recertification. These details outline bidder responsibilities and the project scope.
